definitions.explanation: A long pillow designed to be embraced while sleeping. In everyday use, it is a sleeping aid. In otaku culture, body pillow covers featuring anime or game characters are popular collectibles.

notes:
USAGE:
Has two main contexts of use. As a practical item, it is recommended for pregnant women, side sleepers, and anyone who finds comfort hugging something while sleeping. In otaku culture, {抱|だ}き{枕|まくら}⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧ (body pillow covers) with printed characters are widely sold at anime events and online shops.
